info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Hotel Loyalty Points Partners-v5-spec
info.description: The Hotel Loyalty Points Partners API provides access to a comprehensive list of partners that offer loyalty points for hotel stays. This endpoint enables consumers to retrieve information about various hotel loyalty partners, facilitating users in making informed decisions about loyalty programs. Typical use cases include integrating loyalty information into travel applications, enabling users to maximize points accumulation and redemption options. This API serves developers building applications that enhance customer engagement through effective loyalty programs.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to retrieve information about partner points associated with the system. It provides a list of all partners and their corresponding points, enabling effective management and insights into partner performance.

requestBody.description: Request body for fetching partner points. This request should include the necessary parameters to filter and retrieve partner point information.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the list of partners.
